the glomerular gelatineolytic activity is reduced in the early stages of glomerular sclerosis in obese Zucker rats, due to a reduction of MMP-9 activity, while TIMP1 expression is upregulated.
In obese Zucker rats the development of glomerulosclerosis is associated with increased collagen synthesis, and decreased degradation by matrix metalproteases.
Glomerular gelatinolysis is reduced in obese Zucker rats, which is associated with a decline in gelatinase-B (MMP- 9) activity and mRNA levels, and an increase in TIMP-1 expression.

the role of matrix metalloproteinase and their inhibitors (TIMPs) in the development of diabetic nephropathy.
the pathogenesis of renal disease in diabetes.
the pathogenesis of glomerulosclerosis in obese Zucker rats, which is a model for human obesity combined with insulin-resistance and hyperlipidaemic.

glomerular gelatineolytic activity was decreased in glomeruli of the obese Zucker rats, which was due to the reduced expression and activity of MMP-9 and the enhanced expression and activity of TIMP-1, whereas MMP-2 was not affected.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found that the obese Zucker rat represents an animal model of obesity combined to insulin resistance and hyper-lipidaemia, which spontaneously develops glomerular sclerosis.

we found an increased collagen content, a decreased activity and an up-regulation of the inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinase 1 (TIMP1) and a down-regulation of MMP9 in glomeruli of obese Zucker rats.

the obese Zucker rat represents an animal model for obesity, insulin resistance, dyslipidemia and hypertension, which, over a period of 6–8 months, develops glomerulosclerosis with mesangial expansion, tubulointerstitial fibrosis, and glomerular capillary basement membrane thickening.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the obesity and insulin resistance of the Zucker rat are associated with increased expression of TIMP-1 and a decrease in MMP-9.
the glomeruli in the obese Zucker rat display a marked reduction in the expression and activity of gelatinase B.
obesity is not only a disease of excess adipose tissue but also of the kidney.
